data.gender_notes: Hayiyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'hayyaa', meaning 'to live' or 'living'. In Islamic tradition, the name Hayiyyah signifies the life-giving and nurturing nature of Allah. The name Hayiyyah carries the meaning “Life-giving, Living” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hayiyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody life-giving, living and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name full of life and vitality, reflecting the divine blessings of Allah.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hayiyyah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
